sample_unit: dermatological conditions (patient information leaflets generated per tool)

links.outcome: Readability (SMOG, Flesch Reading Ease, FKGL) of AI-generated leaflets versus recommended 11-year-old reading level
links.effect: Leaflets from ChatGPT-4 and its plugins did not meet the recommended readability range; some had better mean scores than BAD leaflets (Chat with a Dermatologist SMOG P=0.0005, FKGLT P=0.002).
links.quote: The readability scores of PILs generated by ChatGPT-4 and its plugins did not meet the recommended target range.

links.outcome: Whether AI-generated patient education materials are readable by the general public
links.effect: Generated PILs fell short of being easily understood by the general public despite occasionally surpassing BAD PILs in readability.
links.quote: However, these PILs still fall short of being easily understood by the general public, and the content requires rigorous verification by healthcare professionals to ensure reliability and quality.

unlisted_practices: Comparing LLM-generated patient leaflets with specialty society leaflets on content completeness
Comparing dermatology-specific plugins with base ChatGPT-4

screen.reason: The study evaluates the readability and content of patient information leaflets generated by ChatGPT-4 and dermatology-specific plugins compared to standard British Association of Dermatologists leaflets using readability metrics.
